newsitem.title: USA: Successories Oct. same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Successories Oct. same store sales rise.

text.p: Successories Inc said Thursday its comparable store sales in company-owned locations for the four weeks ended November 2 rose 28 percent from the same month a year ago.
Total sales in October increased 32 percent.
For the third quarter ended November, comparable store sales were up 15 percent while total sales advanced 21 percent.
"The last six month trend bodes well for the upcoming holiday season," said James Beltrame, president and chief operating officer, in a statement.
Successories is a specialty retailer and catalog company that designs, makes and markets proprietary products for business and personal motivation.
Shares of Successories closed off 1/4 at 7-1/8.
